newsitem.title: FRANCE: EP approves revised EU-ACP Lome IV Convention.
newsitem.headline: EP approves revised EU-ACP Lome IV Convention.

text.p: The European Parliament approved on Thursday night the revised Lome IV Convention, governing trade and aid relations between the European Union and the African, Caribbean and Pacific (ACP) states.
The revised version of the 1990-2000 convention -- COM(95)707 -- was signed in Mauritius last year.
Euro-MPs said they did not approve of all the changes to the accord made during the mid-term review but recognised an imperfect convention was better for the 70 ACP states than no convention at all.
Parliament's accord was necessary for the revised convention legally to enter into force.
Deevelopment commissioner Joao de Deus Pinheiro agreed with rapporteur Francis Wurtz (France, United Left) on the importance of continuing north-south cooperation after Lome IV expires.
